entries.mem0ai/mem0: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that offers a universal memory layer for AI agents. It supports multi-level memory for User, Session, and Agent states and is available as a managed cloud or Apache-2.0 self-hosted OSS.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes Agent memory provider featuring a custom vector graph engine and sub-300ms recall. It provides RAG, user profiles, and multi-modal extraction for PDFs, images, and videos via a single API.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that unifies agent memories and skills using a filesystem management paradigm. It utilizes tiered L0/L1/L2 loading to reduce token consumption and supports directory recursive retrieval.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: An opinionated brain for Hermes Agents that provides synthesis and gap analysis for queries. It features a self-wiring knowledge graph with typed edges and supports local deployment using PGLite.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: A memory system designed for long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows. It offers Python and Node.js client SDKs and supports Docker-based deployment.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: A memory library for building stateful agents that supports peer-centric modeling and background reasoning. It is available as a managed service or a self-hosted FastAPI server with Python and TypeScript SDKs.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that manages context trees using git-like version control. It features an interactive TUI and supports 20 LLM providers and 24 built-in agent tools.
entries.AxDSan/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency, sub-millisecond memory system for Hermes Agents. It utilizes a single SQLite database and supports MCP and Python SDKs with bidirectional memory sync.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: A recursive self-improving context harness that generates persistent playbooks and hints from iterative task runs. It distills successful agent behaviors into local-model training artifacts.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A lossless context management plugin that uses a SQLite message store with FTS metadata. It provides agent tools for searching and expanding compacted material and supports optional redaction of sensitive patterns.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: A self-hosted Honcho memory backend that enables private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent. It supports any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider and includes an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
entries.plur-ai/plur: A shared memory layer for multi-agent systems that stores memory as plain-text YAML engrams on disk. It supports hierarchical scoping for global and project-specific knowledge.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: A local-first layer for identity, memory, and secrets that provides portable context across multiple agent harnesses and MCP clients. It includes a dedicated dashboard for inspecting and repairing memory.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: An on-device, local-first memory and context engine with no cloud dependencies or API keys. It uses hybrid retrieval via vector search and multi-graph traversal with cross-runtime synchronization via a shared SQLite vault.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: An optimization plugin that reduces prefill latency and saves tokens through block reordering and deduplication. It is natively compatible with the Hermes Agent and OpenClaw ecosystems.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: A durable, file-based long-term memory system that uses SQLite with FTS5 search. It is a local-first architecture that operates without a vector database or embeddings.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: A self-maintaining plugin that provides explainable recall via why_retrieved tags. It includes contradiction tracking and a built-in outcome ledger for agent-authored skills.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: A memory kernel stack that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner. It uses SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide a purpose-built evidence packet per query.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: An anticipatory memory system that prefetches context by watching agent session logs. It uses local-first storage via SQLite-vec and provides an MCP-native server.
entries.keepnotes-ai/keep: A reflective memory system featuring semantic search with BM25 and ranked graph traversal. It supports automated indexing for codebases, URLs, and multimedia with OCR support.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: A tool to reduce Hermes Agent tool-schema overhead through keyword selection and Tool Search. It uses local BM25 tool ranking to reduce prompt token overhead.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: A memory and context layer that resolves live workspace state into verified facts at tool invocation time. It implements the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and supports configuration for Hermes Agent and Cursor.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: A local-only plugin using a columnar.lbdb embedded graph database. It features importance-weighted recall to surface high-priority memories during context prefetch.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: A long-term, cross-project memory system that stores data as inspectable Markdown files. It uses DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache and is daemonless.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: A pull-model episodic memory plugin that supports real, immediate event deletion. It provides an audit trace of prefetch operations via a trace.jsonl log.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: A memory provider that offers cross-agent recall with semantic search and provenance tracking. It supports automatic memory mirroring from Hermes native memory tools.
entries.piprail/piprail: An SDK and MCP server that enables AI agents to pay for API usage using USDC and stablecoins across various blockchain families. It integrates with Hermes and OpenClaw.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: A memory plugin that integrates Exabase M-1 for self-organizing long-term agent memory. It provides tools for searching, manually storing, and reranking retrieval results.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: A local-only plugin providing semantic and literal code search for private repositories. It offers grounded Q&A with file-and-line citations without external network calls.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: A memory provider featuring 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal. It uses hybrid search combining BM25, vector, and graph methods.

entries.obra/superpowers: An agentic skills framework and software development methodology that includes a library of skills for testing, debugging, and collaboration. It supports multiple harnesses including Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot CLI while emphasizing TDD, YAGNI, and DRY principles.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first open-source design and prototyping system that supports HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4 exports. It is compatible with various coding agents and OpenAI-compatible endpoints and includes features for automation and design system management.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: A collection of 817 production-grade cybersecurity skills mapped to six major frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and NIST CSF 2.0. These skills cover 29 security domains and are compatible with 26+ AI platforms and Hermes Agent.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: A tool that generates draw.io diagrams from natural language descriptions and converts Mermaid text into editable files. It supports 11 diagram type presets and includes self-check and auto-fix capabilities.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: An auditing and rewriting tool designed to eliminate detectable AI writing patterns using a 111-entry word replacement table and 53 pattern categories. It supports Claude Code, OpenClaw, Hermes, and Cursor via a two-pass detection system.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: A framework for collective skill evolution that provides automated skill deduplication and quality improvement. It enables unified skill libraries across multiple agents, devices, and shared user teams.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform skills library compatible with Claude Code, Codex, and agentskills.io agents. It features 12 metaskills for guided business and code journeys and includes 50 expert frameworks from bestselling books.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: A trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce that provides adjudication for deals, including escrow and dispute resolution. It utilizes natural-language mandates, ERC-7710 delegated permissions, and x402 payments.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that automatically detects and proposes reusable skills from active workflows. It generates Python plugin scaffolds and SKILL.md documentation, providing slash commands to manage and save detected patterns.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: Implements the Agent Skills open specification for Pydantic AI to provide type-safe support. It reduces token usage through progressive disclosure of skill metadata and supports both programmatic and filesystem-based Python skill definitions.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: Provides YouTube transcript, search, channel, and playlist skills for Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, Claude Code, Cursor, and Windsurf. It extracts transcripts and captions without using yt-dlp and supports video search and channel browsing.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: A skill set that enables Hermes Agent to write its own analytical prompts through dynamic generation of custom analytical lenses. It includes seven pre-built prisms for simulation and optimization, alongside constraint reporting to identify analysis blind spots.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: A workflow skill that converts rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents. It features Lite and Full modes for varying complexity and includes a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: A harness for long-running AI agents that supports a three-level work model. It provides structured memory using file-backed or SQLite-backed cards and includes a CLI for task and card management.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: A literate programming skill that weaves code and documentation together by generating.lit.md files. It uses a tangler to extract runnable source files from documentation and automatically syncs edits back to the literate document.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: A plugin providing self-memory and replacement models through cross-instance shared memory via markdown files. It features an automated pipeline for capturing high-value decisions to facilitate fine-tuning and switching to replacement models.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Provides oracle network and smart contract interaction skills following the agentskills.io specification. It supports integration with CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds, including specialized skills for CRE and ACE services.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: Official FLUX image generation skills that provide standardized prompting guidelines for the FLUX.1 and FLUX.2 model families. It includes API integration patterns for webhooks, polling, and error handling, as well as support for JSON structured prompting.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: A tool that converts repositories, documentation, and developer discourse into agentskills.io-compliant skills. It generates version-pinned instruction files and provides provenance via documentation URLs or file:line citations.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: A registry for reusable AI skills based on the AgentSkills specification. It includes a Python SkilldockClient and a CLI, supporting skill installation with recursive dependency resolution and TON-based commerce features.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: A skill for complex multi-step task execution that features autonomous execution for long-running tasks. It provides real-time progress tracking and built-in rollback procedures for safe recovery.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: A progressive MCP client that utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage. It features a socket-based daemon architecture for persistent connections and incremental discovery of tool schemas.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: A Hermes Agent skill for managing Nextcloud files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts via WebDAV and CalDAV. It communicates securely over HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided setup script.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: A workflow language for AI implemented as a single Rust binary under the AGPL-3.0 license. It provides static auditing for secrets, cost, and types, and features hash-chained, tamper-evident execution receipts.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: A five-layer intelligent skill retrieval system that uses semantic embeddings and hard triggers to reduce token usage. It employs RFS fusion and provides graceful degradation if dependencies or embedding models are missing.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: A plugin that rewrites and scores prompts across various surfaces including CLI, TUI, Discord, and Telegram. It tailors rewrites based on model reasoning capability and tracks quality scores and token savings in a local SQLite database.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: An adversarial bug-hunting code review tool that uses three parallel subagents to analyze edge cases and integration risks. It includes a deterministic pre-scan layer and a feedback MCP server to generate suppression rules for false positives.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: A C# /.NET implementation of agentskills.io that integrates with MCP. It supports automatic registration of common agent skill directories and implements progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: Adapts verified procedures to implement multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It provides a systematic investigation protocol for causal debugging and a Python goal engine for task state management.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: A multi-agent code simplification skill that utilizes a three-agent swarm targeting hygiene, clarity, and correctness. It features a risk-tiered triage system and language-specific detection for concurrency anti-patterns and N+1 queries.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: A community hub for browsing, searching, and one-click installation of skills. It implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification and features federated search integration with GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: A CLI and MCP server that allows users to search over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills. It provides direct installation commands for discovered tools and integrates with MCP-compatible clients like Hermes and Cursor.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: An Openclaw skill that automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC. It is compatible with Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, and the agentskills.io standard, supporting AP2, MPP, and x402 protocols.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: A multi-scale Chinese news briefing generator that produces structured reports from global to street level. It includes quality gates, AI analysis, and integrates user interests via semantic memory for search expansion.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes, with support for both binary and source-based installations. It features daily automated updates for all included packages and includes agents from providers such as Google and OpenAI.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: This repository contains scripts and notes for running agent CLIs, including Hermes Agent, on Android smartphones via Termux. It provides an automated installer for Antigravity CLI on ARM64 and configuration guides for running OpenClaw using Termux:API and Termux:GUI.
entries.rookiemann/portable-hermes-agent: This is a zero-install Windows desktop agent that requires no admin rights and operates without Docker. It features a GUI, an integrated workflow engine for automated multi-step pipelines, and an extensive toolset including TTS, Music, and ComfyUI.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This project offers an automated Termux-based installer and guide for running Hermes Agent on Android devices. It supports local model execution via Ollama and is compatible with providers like OpenAI and Anthropic.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This unofficial community Helm chart enables deployment on Kubernetes with cloud-native state-safety guardrails for persistent HERMES_HOME storage. It supports direct deployment or operator-ready CRD-based workflows and offers a configurable gateway mode with optional API and webhook listeners.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: This project provides hardware-level enforcement for Hermes Agent sandboxing via NVIDIA OpenShell. It utilizes kernel-level restrictions for network and filesystem access and allows for configurable security policies regarding messaging and web search.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a simple Docker sandbox image that includes the official Hermes installation and mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted home directories and allows for building specific Hermes tags using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module enables reproducible Hermes deployment through declarative configuration of workspace documents and cli-config.yaml. It features hybrid skill management and secure secrets integration via sops-nix and systemd EnvironmentFiles.
entries.solomon2773/nora: This self-hosted control plane is designed to deploy, monitor, and operate OpenClaw and Hermes AI agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It provides per-agent metrics, costs, and LLM budget caps, and includes a REST API, CLI, and MCP server.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: This Docker-first control plane orchestrates multiple Hermes Agent instances with separate identities and workspaces through a single web application. It features hierarchy-aware inter-agent delegation, task scheduling, and enterprise MCP access for external AI client integrations.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This project enables production-ready, headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian servers by configuring Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service. It supports the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and includes Nous Portal integration.

entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform enables task dispatching, multi-agent workflow execution, and spend monitoring. It provides a Web UI, CLI, MCP server, and REST API alongside a memory browser and relationship graph.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This project provides a TUI and PWA web dashboard for monitoring multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It supports parallel execution across git worktrees and utilizes Docker, Podman, or Apple Containers for agent sandboxing.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This template utilizes a tiered architecture and a task bus pattern to scale from single VPS agents to automated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for VPS setup, security auditing, and registry management.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Designed for scaling Hermes Agent from single agents to automated teams, this template uses a level-based architecture and a task bus pattern for delegation. It features bundled skills for VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework facilitates building autonomous agent swarms with support for over 23 LLM providers, including OpenAI and Ollama. It features durable agent memory, MCP tool integration, and visual org charts for team delegation.
entries.Agent-3-7/minions: This mission control interface allows users to create, supervise, and review autonomous Hermes Agent work from a single screen. It includes a Kanban board for task tracking and live streaming of agent reasoning and tool execution.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system coordinates 17 specialized agents for research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure. It utilizes a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for routing and coordination.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local collaboration system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents for automated task lifecycle management. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols and provides a real-time Web UI for monitoring agent dialogues and Kanban flows.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates 9 autonomous agents representing two competing AI companies to compete for GitHub stars. It uses Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and provides a real-time dashboard for tasks, code, and scoreboard metrics.
entries.Rainhoole/hermes-agent-acp-skill: This tool routes tasks between Hermes subagents, Codex, and Claude Code using ACP-style delegation. It prevents parent context pollution through isolated workflows and enforces safety via configurable timeouts and output character limits.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: A local pre-indexed code knowledge graph that reduces token usage and tool calls for Hermes Agent. It supports TypeScript, Python, Go, and Rust via an MCP server and operates with an auto-syncing index.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: A CLI tool featuring a native Rust TUI for high-performance local monitoring of token usage and costs. It provides tracking integrations for Hermes Agent, Claude Code, Gemini, and Cursor.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: A local trace viewer used to inspect system prompts, tool calls, and streaming API traffic from Hermes Agent and other coding agents. It allows users to debug behavior by comparing adjacent requests and exporting HTML trace artifacts.
entries.bergside/typeui: An MCP-based tool that provides design systems and layout guidance to help AI build better UIs. It integrates with Hermes Agent, Cursor, Claude, and GitHub Copilot.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: An opinionated workflow layer that coordinates seven specialized agents to build and operate apps. It includes 36 skills and 6 workflows for autonomous operation on laptops or VPS.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: A collection of community CLI themes for the Hermes terminal UI. It uses YAML-based configuration to customize ASCII art banners, spinners, and colors with aesthetics like cyberpunk and retro DOS.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: A social economy for autonomous agents featuring identity registration with human-readable @handles. It supports Solana-based USDC and SOL payments and encrypted messaging via the Signal Protocol.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: A port of the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel. It runs natively without OAuth or external processes and includes MLOps tools for RL training and vLLM or GGUF inference.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: An AI-native browser that enables autonomous agent control via MCP. It features a visible UI for real-time supervision, session management, and an integrated research desk.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: A TAW Agent framework that creates scoped Hermes Agents using per-folder local configurations. It allows for project-local memories, tools, and custom instructions while switching between default and scoped agents.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: A setup utilizing RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings. It provides 40+ pre-configured skills for research, devops, and finance with automated installation for Linux and macOS.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: An automated installation tool that deploys a Hermes Agent stack and 12+ supporting services. It offers three scalable deployment tiers and support for 29 community plugins.
entries.roli-lpci/lintlang: A static linter that uses seven structural detectors to scan agent configs, system prompts, and tool descriptions without LLM calls. It supports .prompt, JSON, YAML, and plain text formats.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: A migration tool that transfers agent personas, memories, skills, and workspace files from OpenClaw to Hermes Agent. It maps OpenClaw model configurations to Hermes YAML format and handles credential transfers.
entries.observeco/observeco: A self-healing observability system that monitors multi-agent systems without cloud dependencies. It includes a beta Hermes plugin for exporting tool call and API request telemetry to track memory bloat and cost estimation.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: A cross-platform manager for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw, Gemini CLI, and Hermes Agent. It is built with Tauri 2 for efficient desktop performance on Windows, macOS, and Linux.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: A local open-source cowork app that unifies multiple CLI agents, including Hermes Agent and OpenClaw, into one interface. It features a built-in agent engine with zero configuration and automates document creation for PPT, Word, and Excel.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: A web-based interface providing full parity with the Hermes CLI experience. It features a three-panel layout with workspace file browsing and supports secure remote access via SSH tunneling.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: A desktop companion app designed for installing, configuring, and chatting with Hermes Agent. It provides a GUI for managing sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers through a guided setup.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-web-ui: A web dashboard that supports multi-platform AI chat, session management, and scheduled jobs. It includes a file browser, web terminal, and unified configuration for channels like Telegram, Discord, Slack, and WhatsApp.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: A native web workspace featuring a chat interface, terminal, memory browser, skills manager, and inspector panel. It supports Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: A native Mac workspace that connects to Hermes hosts via local or SSH connections. It includes embedded terminal access for system repair and native views for sessions, Kanban, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: A Chromium side-panel extension that connects active browser contexts to local, Hermes Cloud, or remote gateways. It provides a full-page Hermes Web workspace for Chrome, Edge, and Chromium.
entries.Eynzof/hermes-agent-cn-desktop: A Windows-first desktop application built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust. It supports Windows and macOS and includes a built-in Hermes-CN-Core runtime with LaTeX and Markdown rendering.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: A self-hosted web dashboard providing a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and agent status panel. It features real-time chat with tool call visualization and an MCP server control plane.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser and agent cockpit that supports Codex, Claude, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot CLI. It provides per-session API-equivalent spend reporting using local-only data processing.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: A native macOS workspace designed for running Hermes Agent on Orgo cloud computers and SSH hosts. It features one-click automated installation and integrated WebRTC voice mode.
entries.liftaris/herm: An alternative Hermes TUI and dashboard built with OpenTUI. It consolidates chat, sessions, and configuration into a terminal dashboard with integrated kanban boards and an extensible Eikon avatar system.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A React-based Telegram Mini App dashboard featuring a mobile-first UI. It supports terminal chat with streaming responses and background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: A portable, no-install Windows desktop application that requires no admin rights or Docker. It includes 100 tools, a workflow engine for multi-step automation, and support for local models via LM Studio.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A glassmorphic web interface for self-hosted Hermes Agent chat and real-time log streaming. It includes an integrated file browser and a dashboard for managing tasks, skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: A process monitoring and configuration dashboard for Hermes. It provides real-time tracking of session activity and costs, alongside inspection of conversation histories and skill source code.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A self-hosted AI workspace featuring chat with real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards. It includes an integrated marketplace for skills and MCP servers, alongside isolated profile management.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: A multi-agent desktop client that orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents. It features a visual Skill Store with over 50 curated installations and a native interface for streaming responses.
